Description: A cairn of dwarven helmets rises from the cave floor, bound together by threads of glowing mycelium. Each helmet is stuffed with offerings: coins, amulets, teeth. The air around the cairn is clean and still, as though the spores themselves refuse to come closer.

Replies.ReplyText: Lay a coin on the cairn.
Replies.SsText: The mycelium threads pulse softly as your coin sinks into the cairn. Warmth floods your limbs and the weariness of the tunnels lifts.

Replies.ReplyText: Pry the amulets from the stones.
Replies.SsText: You work the amulets free one by one. The threads do not stir.
Replies.FlText: The threads snap tight. The cairn shudders and its guardians tear themselves free of the stones.

Replies.SsText: Beneath the cairn you find a cache of crystallized spore dust that someone buried long ago.
Replies.FlText: The ground gives way and you tumble into a pit of spore-laden roots.
